get.summary:
Lists all storage entries for the owner under a given index prefix. Use
filter and extract to filter and extract the data and iterate over the data
efficiently.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The address of the owner of the storage entry.

parameters.name: index_prefix
parameters.description: The index prefix of the storage entry to filter by.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
The optional gjson filter to filter the storage entry.
Supports GJSON query syntax with comparison operators:
- Equality: status == "active", age == 18
- Inequality: type != "test"
- Comparison: age > 18, count <= 100, score >= 50
- Pattern matching: name % "John*" (like), tag !% "*beta*" (not like)
Only entries matching the filter will be included in results.

parameters.name: extract
parameters.description:
The optional gjson path to extract from the storage entry. For example,
Given data like {"user": {"name": "jeff"}}, the extract "user.name" will
return "jeff".

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

count_total.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

reverse.description:
reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending
order.

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

next_key.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise

max_storage_size.title:
max_storage_size defines the maximum storage size in bytes that can be
stored per owner

storage_stake_multiple.description:
storage_stake_multiple defines the stake requirement multiplier per byte
stored. Value "0" disables stake requirements entirely.

dysonprotocol.storage.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the storage module.

owner.description: owner is the account address that owns storage entries.

total_bytes.description:
total_bytes is the total number of bytes consumed by all storage entries
for this owner address.

min_stake_amount.description:
min_stake_amount is the minimum stake required in udys for the current
storage usage (total_bytes × storage_stake_multiple).

current_stake_amount.description:
current_stake_amount is the owner's current total delegated stake in udys
across all validators.

dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryMetricsRes.description: QueryMetricsResponse is response type for the Query/Metrics RPC method.

params.description: params holds all the parameters of this module.

dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryParamsResp.description: QueryParamsResponse is response type for the Query/Params RPC method.

owner.description: owner is the account address that owns this storage entry.

index.description:
index is the key/index for the storage entry (within the owner's
namespace).

data.description: data is the stored string value associated with the index.

updated_height.description: updated_height is block height of last modification.

updated_timestamp.description:
updated_timestamp is the block time in UTC (RFC3339 e.g.
"2025-06-11T15:23:00Z") when entry was modified.

hash.description: hash is SHA-256 hex of data field.
